title: Samba Spotlight mdssvc RPC Request Infinite Loop Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Samba. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of Spotlight RPC arguments. Crafted arguments can force the server into an infinite loop. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the service.
